name: abtag-v1
run: cd /work && python -m py_compile fetch_mods.py > /out/compile.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/compile.txt; exit $rc

cd /work && python fetch_mods.py > /out/fetch.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/fetch.txt; python -m py_compile abtag.py test_abtag.py >> /out/compile.txt 2>&1 || rc=1; sha256sum abtag.py test_abtag.py dmcratio.py aprime_cross.py aleph-abtag24.json aleph-fig5.json aleph-dmc21.json aleph-emu3.json | tee /out/sha256.txt; exit $rc
cd /work && python -m unittest -v test_aprime_cross test_dmcratio test_abtag > /out/tests.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/tests.txt; exit $rc
cd /work && python abtag.py --abtag aleph-abtag24.json --fig5 aleph-fig5.json --dmc aleph-dmc21.json --emu aleph-emu3.json --out /out > /out/run.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/run.txt; exit $rc
